notes.title: UPDATE V2.1.0
notes.notes:
[b]	New features[/b]
		- Added time and score leaderboards in the title screen.
		- Added full ps4 and ps5 support. Now you can choose the right icons for those controllers.
[b]
	Bugs[/b]
		- Fixed getting stuck in level 7.
		- Fixed not being able to chain a super flip with a norml and super dash, and viceversa.
		- Fixed buggy green door in level 6.
		- Fixed boss 1's segments not breaking after detaching from the boss.
		- Fixed when using the super laser a regular shot doesn't come out.
	
[b]	Mechanical and level design changes [/b]
		- Lowered health of relentless cube from 26 to 24 (the purple and green cube enemy).
		- Now, metal boxes can destroy multiple enemies instead of only one.
		- Now, enemies don't flash when hit unless you shoot them up-close; this is to make it more obvious that the player is dealing double damage.
		- Layout changes to the tutorial level to better teach how the super dash and super flip work.
		- Now, time doesn't run if you are in the teleporter.
			
[b]	Others
[/b]		- Moved Discord button from the title screen to the main options.
		- Removed "delete save file" button.
		- Tweaks to several songs.
		- Some typos were corrected in Both English and Spanish.
		- Now, when you defeat a boss there's a new animation that plays when you grab the win orb (the item that makes the score screen show up).

notes.title: UPDATE v2.0.84
notes.notes:
- Now you can buffer a dash or super dash even if you are already dashing.
- Fixed red boxes being coving the pause menu.
- Fixed pause menu freezing when pressing with ESC and ENTER/SPACE
- Fixed getting stuck when going from one type of platform to the other
- Fixed camera offset not updating when super dashing

notes.title: Two Days After Release, Update v2.0.77, and Future Updates/DLC
notes.notes: [h2]Two Days After Release[/h2][p]After a year and a half of development, Gravity Storm is finally out. I know I should've made this announcement sooner, but I've been pretty overwhelmed with the release of my first commercial game on Steam. Two days after release, GS has gotten 32 sales, or at least that's what Steam says, from what I heard, it might take a while to update the numbers properly, it might be a few sales off. Also, at the time of writing this post, GS (Gravity Storm) only has 5 reviews.[/p][p]Although for a year I did a lot of promotion of this game on several platforms, G is under-performing. I was expecting at least a 100 sales by now, but maybe after getting more reviews, posts and content creators playing GS, things might change. For context, I was hoping at least 3,000 sales in the first 2 months, but it doesn't seem possible anymore. [/p][p]I truly appreciate everyone who bought Gravity Storm, and I hope you all have fun playing it. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="uQg5W7muk60;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Update v2.0.77 [/h2][list][*][p]Fixed [b]wrong music[/b] playing in zone 5.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]Gamepad[/b] [b]vibration not stopping[/b] after playing certain modes or pressing the pause button.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]boss 3 getting stuck[/b] in the wall when flipping gravity at the start of the fight.[/p][/*][*][p]Many [b]typos[/b] have been corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]Some [b]sound effects are louder[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p]I only mention the main changes since release here. No game-breaking bugs so far, I got lucky! thank you so much to my playtesters. If you find a bug, please let me know.[/p][p][/p][h2]Future Updates/DLC[/h2][p]This is a list of the plans I have for the game, some of these aren't guarantee to happen, but I'll try to make most of them a reality. [b]If you see a (*),[/b] it means it's not very likely to happen, unless the game sales well.[/p][p][/p][h3]Free[/h3][list][*][p][b]Enemy bestiary[/b], a list of enemies with their names and a small descriptions of them.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Leaderboards [/b]for time records and score records.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Versus mode [/b]where you can fight a friend locally, Gravity Storm vs another Gravity Storm.*[/p][/*][*][p][b]Arranged mode[/b] where most enemies have different patterns and the game is harder.*[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug fixes and balance patches. [/b]I'll try to keep the game is bug-free and balanced as possible. I mean "balanced" in terms of level design, mechanics and difficulty.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Paid[/h3][list][*][p][b]Downloadable Soundtrack[/b]. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Mini-metroidvania epilogue, [/b]a playable DLC set right after the main story where Gravity Storm gets back to Earth, loses its powers, has to get them back, and has to escape a military base.* [/p][/*][/list][p]There might be more more updates, nothing is set in Stone right now. Thanks for reading![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update v1.3.93, Release date?, and Discord Server.
notes.notes: [h3][u][b]Changelog[/b][/u][/h3][list][*][p][b]Combo system added[/b]. Now if you destroy two enemies fast enough, a combo will start, you'll have two seconds to destroy another enemy to continue the combos. Combos give you 100 extra points for each enemy destroyed during the combo. You can keep your combo as long as there are enemies close by and you can destroy them fast enough. This is a feature I've been meaning to add for a while, and it might be broken like the score system, I'll let you be the judge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The tutorial received several improvement.[/b] These improvements should make certain mechanics more clear both for new players and old ones. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Some sound effect are lower and the music is a bit louder.[/b] More sound effect options are on their way.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Other changes:[/b] checkpoint gives you health, the time bonus is now longer, some minor changes to the level design. There are other changes I might be forgetting. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][u][b]Plans[/b][/u][/h3][p]The Next Fest got me quite busy, and I have not been making as much progress as usually. However, once it's over, I will focus completely in the development of Gravity Storm and hopefully release it in July, but that date might change. I will release a release date trailer when the game is finished.[/p][p][/p][h3][b][u]Discord server[/u][/b][/h3][p]Here's an invite to my server, if you want to join: [url="https://discord.com/invite/npVqwtrTPX"]Jampley Games Server[/url][/p][p]Most Gravity Storm players are in my Discord server, that's where I post the latest new about the game and interact with the community more often. You can share your own games, art and music. We are having an art contest next week, and a game jam hopefully next month. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Have fun playing![/p]
